notes: Covista appears to be the renamed parent of Adtalem Global Education; tuition model and delivery mix are partly inferred from the evidence and prior knowledge.

education_level_institution_type.value: Postsecondary healthcare educator operating five institutions: medical, veterinary, nursing and graduate/professional universities

program_qualification.value: Nursing (BSN, nurse practitioner), medicine (MD), veterinary (DVM), behavioral health, certificate and CME programs

enrollment_by_measure.value: Serves about 100,000 students across five institutions; headcount of students, not full-time-equivalent or course registrations

tuition_payment_model.value: Student tuition, plus employer partnerships with scholarships and loan repayment tied to employment commitments

accreditation_authorization.value: Five accredited institutions; accreditor names not given in the evidence

completion_student_outcomes.value: First-time residency attainment rate at medical schools is very high; large annual graduate output; nursing schools ranked highly

delivery_campus_model.value: Hybrid: campus, simulation labs and clinical rotations at hundreds of partner hospitals, with employer-embedded cohorts
